text: dsh-subagent-codex-plus 为 DSH Web 提供 Codex 子代理和直连网关。它注册 codex-plus 提供方，并用 /codex-lock、/codex-unlock 绑定或解除当前会话与 Codex 线程；浏览器界面显示会话状态和排队消息。用户可委派一次性任务，也可持续直连 Codex，并编辑、置顶、插入或删除排队消息。DSH 重启后会尝试恢复绑定。源码未声明单独的 API key 配置项；运行需有本地 Codex app-server 环境。

dsh-subagent-codex-plus connects DSH web sessions to Codex and registers a one-shot subagent provider. Use /codex-lock or /codex-unlock to bind or unbind threads. Its browser UI shows status and manages queued messages. Bindings are restored after restart. It uses the local Codex app-server.
想在 DSH 里把当前会话直接接到 Codex，持续对话而不经过 DSH 模型吗？
如何把一项任务交给 Codex 子代理单独运行？
How can I connect a DSH session to a Codex thread for an ongoing conversation?
dsh-subagent-codex-plus 的功能「Codex 直连」：/codex-lock 绑定 Codex 线程，/codex-unlock 解除绑定；重启后会尝试恢复连接。
dsh-subagent-codex-plus 的功能「排队管理」：用户可在悬浮面板查看队列，并编辑、置顶、插入或删除消息。

dsh-subagent-codex-plus README · dsh-subagent-codex-plus：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

**This plugin is forked from the official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex` plugin**. It keeps the official one-shot Codex delegation exactly as upstream ships it, and layers a set of extensions on top so that **Codex becomes a first-class citizen inside DeepSeek Harness (dsh)**: continuous conversation, live intermediate output, and a true-gateway mode where dsh only relays bytes between you and a Codex session — no model runs in between.

dsh-subagent-codex-plus README · Relationship with dsh-subagent-pi：[`dsh-subagent-pi`](https://github.com/february2015/dsh-subagent-pi) is the **sibling plugin** of this one: both are personal forks of the official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex` that add the same true-gateway layer on top — direct connection, queued/steered continuous conversation, live intermediate output, durable binding, and image passthrough. They differ only in the direct-connected agent — **Codex** here, **Pi** in `dsh-subagent-pi` — and share the same architecture, so features, commands, and docs map one-to-one:

dsh-subagent-codex-plus README · Relationship with dsh-subagent-pi：| | `dsh-subagent-codex-plus` (this plugin) | `dsh-subagent-pi` |
|---|---|---|
| Direct-connected agent | Codex | Pi |
| Lock command | `/codex-lock` | `/pi-lock` |
| Unlock command | `/codex-unlock` | `/pi-unlock` |
| Header badge | `CDX-xxxx` | `PI-xxxx` |

Both projects live under the same GitHub account and are maintained in parallel. Pick either — or install both; each binds its own sessions and they coexist without interference.

dsh-subagent-codex-plus README · 1. True-gateway direct connection (core)：One local command binds your **current dsh conversation 1:1 to a durable Codex thread**; from then on everything you type in the dsh composer goes straight to Codex — **dsh runs no model in between, it only relays**.

dsh-subagent-codex-plus README · 1. True-gateway direct connection (core)：- `/codex-lock` binds the session to a persistent Codex thread.
- `/codex-unlock` unbinds and restores the normal dsh agent loop; the Codex thread is kept and can be rebound anytime.
- **Durable binding**: after shutting down / restarting dsh, reopening the session auto-reconnects the same Codex thread (connection contention handled automatically), no manual step needed.
- One Codex thread can be bound to only one dsh session.

dsh-subagent-codex-plus README · 2. Continuous conversation: queue + direct insert：- While Codex is busy, new messages are **queued** automatically and appear immediately in the native composer queue strip (visible, editable, deletable, steerable), running in order when the current turn ends.
- The floating panel can **insert** a message directly (it runs ahead of queued messages on the next turn).
- The queue is fully manageable: the native queue strip can view/edit/delete/steer; the floating panel can insert/cancel.

dsh-subagent-codex-plus README · 3. Live intermediate output：Codex's execution progress (reasoning summaries, message deltas, tool calls, status events) shows up in the dsh session in near real time — not just the final answer. By default it is display-only and never enters the dsh model context.

Long-running tool calls get a **heartbeat**: while a tool item is open, the composer-dock status line shows `正在执行 <tool>` and, after one minute, the live elapsed time (`已运行 4 分 30 秒`). A multi-minute local command therefore never looks like a hang.

dsh-subagent-codex-plus README · 4. Status display：Once bound, the session header shows a `CDX-xxxx` badge (colored status dot + first 4 thread id chars) and the composer dock shows a "Codex 直连 · …" status line. **Unbound sessions show nothing**, keeping the UI clean.

dsh-subagent-codex-plus README · 5. Image / attachment passthrough：Paste or upload images and hand them to Codex as-is (Codex's own model can see them when it has vision). Vision fallback is handled by the TeamAI skill `ocgw-vision`.

dsh-subagent-codex-plus README · 6. Delegation and gateway coexist：One dsh conversation can hold multiple one-shot delegated Codex runs (model-triggered) **and** at most one user-attached gateway session, switching freely between them.

dsh-subagent-codex-plus README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add /path/to/dsh-subagent-codex-plus
dsh --profile <name>
```

dsh-subagent-codex-plus README · Usage：1. Open any dsh session (cwd is your project).
2. Type `/codex-lock`: after binding succeeds the header shows a `CDX-xxxx` badge, and input goes straight to Codex.
3. While Codex is busy, further messages queue automatically and show up immediately in the native composer queue strip (edit/delete/steer), running in order when the current turn ends.
4. `/codex-unlock` disconnects; the Codex thread is kept and can be rebound anytime.
dsh-subagent-codex-plus README · Delegation (official baseline, unchanged)：```yaml

dsh-subagent-codex-plus README · dsh profile settings：- id: tool-subagent-codex
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
  config:
    provider: codex-plus
    toolName: subagent_codex
    backgroundMode: one-shot
```
